themes_detail.label: Dead Animal Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Dead animal complaints spiked to 7 this week compared to a 1.0-per-week baseline over the prior 8 weeks—a 600% increase with z-score 6.93—signaling either a public health event, environmental condition, or seasonal wildlife pattern requiring immediate investigation.
evidence: 7 dead animal complaints filed THIS WEEK vs. 1.0 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Complaints concentrated in current week suggests acute event or condition change
reporting_angles: Interview NYC Parks and Sanitation to identify what triggered the spike—disease outbreak, food source, construction disturbance, or seasonal migration pattern
Document resident complaints and health concerns; check for any concurrent rat, pigeon, or other pest spikes in 311 data

themes_detail.label: Construction Lead Dust Surge
themes_detail.summary: Construction lead dust complaints jumped to 7 this week versus a 1.1-per-week baseline—a 522% spike (z-score 5.04)—coinciding with 126 new building permits and 18 demolitions filed in the district over the past 90 days, raising child health exposure risks.
evidence: 7 construction lead dust complaints filed THIS WEEK vs. 1.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
126 new building permits and 18 full demolitions filed in past 90 days; Fordham Landing South rezoning and 2553 University Avenue projects active in review
reporting_angles: Identify which active construction sites are generating lead dust violations; interview DOB to assess compliance with lead-safe work practices and RRP certification
Investigate whether contractors on Fordham Landing South, 2553 University Ave, or other sites are following EPA lead remediation standards; report health risks to nearby schools/daycare centers

themes_detail.label: Derelict Vehicles Double
themes_detail.summary: Derelict vehicle complaints doubled to 18 last week from a 9.0-per-week baseline—a 100% spike (z-score 6.0)—suggesting either enforcement gaps, parking policy changes, or abandoned vehicle accumulation in the district.
evidence: 18 derelict vehicle complaints filed last week vs. 9.0 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Z-score: 6.0 (severe statistical anomaly); sustained over 1-week period
Illegal parking also elevated at 1,631 complaints over 90-day period (chronic baseline issue)
reporting_angles: Map derelict vehicle complaints geographically; identify neighborhoods most affected (e.g., near Webster Ave, University Ave, or along major corridors)
Interview NYPD Traffic Enforcement and Sanitation to understand whether staffing, towing capacity, or policy changes contributed to surge

themes_detail.label: Illegal Dumping Surge
themes_detail.summary: Illegal dumping complaints surged 196% last week to 17 complaints versus a 5.8-per-week baseline (z-score 5.34), suggesting environmental crime escalation and potential connection to nearby construction activity and rezoning projects.
evidence: 17 illegal dumping complaints filed last week vs. 5.8 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Correlates with 209 alteration permits and construction activity; may indicate unvetted waste disposal by contractors or waste haulers
reporting_angles: Investigate whether active construction sites (Fordham Landing South, 2553 University Ave) are improperly disposing of demolition/renovation debris; audit contractor waste management practices
Interview Sanitation Department on enforcement action and identify dumping hotspots; check whether any illegal waste facilities or transfer stations have opened nearby

themes_detail.label: Cannabis Retailer Complaints Jump
themes_detail.summary: Cannabis retailer complaints increased 269% last week to 6 complaints versus a 1.6-per-week baseline (z-score 6.29), suggesting either unlicensed retail expansion, community opposition to licensed storefronts, or quality/operation concerns requiring enforcement attention.
evidence: 6 cannabis retailer complaints filed last week vs. 1.6 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Complaints likely include unlicensed retailers, odor, operating violations, or youth access concerns
reporting_angles: Map cannabis retailer locations in district; cross-reference against NYC's official licensed retailer database to identify any unlicensed operations

Interview community members and business owners about concerns (odor, youth loitering, storefront density); contact NYC Office of Cannabis Management on enforcement actions in Kingsbridge/Bedford Park
